# Tradecovex

> Tradecovex is a trade copier and AI trade journal for NinjaTrader futures traders, made by IVAAN INC in Toronto, Canada. The copier runs as a local NinjaTrader add-on and replicates trades from one lead account to many follower accounts. The journal analyses the trader's own results and describes patterns in them. It does not recommend trades and is not investment advice.

Who it is for: futures day traders on NinjaTrader who run several prop firm accounts (Apex, Topstep, MyFundedFutures, Take Profit Trader, Tradeify, Bulenox and similar).

How the guides are written: the prop firm rule guides updated in October 2026 were checked against the firm's own help center and say so on the page. Where a rule could not be confirmed, the page says so. Rules change often, so treat the firm's current page as final.

Key facts
- Platform: NinjaTrader 8 (futures). Other platforms are on the roadmap, not available.
- Architecture: local NinjaTrader add-on, with optional cloud features for AI journal analysis and license checks.
- Pricing, current plans and the waitlist: https://tradecovex.com/
- Legal entity: IVAAN INC, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Contact: support@tradecovex.com
